Class JavaFxView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.view.gui.JavaFxView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameView
public class JavaFxView extends Object implements GameView
JavaFX implementation of GameView.

It is instantiated on the network thread by ClientController and bridges calls to GameBoardView, which lives on the JavaFX Application Thread.

Threading:

  • All showXxx methods are asynchronous: they wrap the UI update in Platform.runLater(Runnable).
  • All requestXxx methods are blocking: they render the prompt on the UI and wait for the user's choice through a BlockingQueue.

Race-free initialisation: the network thread can receive early server messages, especially ROUND_STARTED, before showBoard(String) has loaded the FXML and created the GameBoardView. To avoid losing those events, all showXxx/requestXxx methods go through whenReady(Consumer). If the controller is ready, the action runs immediately; otherwise it is queued in pendingActions and replayed in order once showBoard(String) completes.

The queue is only for pre-initialisation calls. Once the controller reference is set, later calls run immediately.

    • showBoard

      public void showBoard(String myNickname)
      Builds and shows the board in the stage. Call this after the lobby has confirmed the connection; the method synchronises with the JavaFX Application Thread.

      When this method returns, GameBoardView is available and all previously queued events have been replayed.

    • showLeaderboard

      public void showLeaderboard(String recipient, int myScore, int myRank, int totalEntries, int numPlayers, List<LeaderboardEntry> leaderboard)
      Description copied from interface: GameView
      Displays the persistent leaderboard delivered by the server after a game ends (DB leaderboard feature).

      The same method is invoked on every client: each instance receives its own recipient, score and rank, plus the same global leaderboard restricted to games with the same number of players.

      Specified by:
      showLeaderboard in interface GameView
      Parameters:
      recipient - nickname this leaderboard message is addressed to
      myScore - final score the recipient obtained in this game
      myRank - 1-based position of the recipient among all the games with the given size; -1 if unknown
      totalEntries - total number of recorded scores for that size
      numPlayers - number of players the game had
      leaderboard - ranked entries for games with that many players
